shared_tail.surface: عامر بن عبد الله بن الزبير

notes: two taḥwīl branches (Amr b. Awn; Musaddad) each write Khalid; the text writes the rest once after Khalid in the second branch, so Bayan to Zubayr is the shared tail
«- المعنى -» and «- قال مسدد أبو بشر -» are glosses: the second says Musaddad's form of the name (Abu Bishr) for the same place; it is not a route and is not merged with Bayan (rule 9)
«عن أبيه، قال قلت للزبير» : the father (Abdullah b. al-Zubayr) is the asker, a relation link; the Companion al-Zubayr is the one asked and answers, so he is the last link (rule 5)
